venue_notes: PROVISIONAL: the brief date of 2026-09-12 has already passed (today is 2026-10-13) and is unconfirmed. Javier will confirm it with Itzel. Do not confirm, deposit or sign anything, and treat every time and quantity as provisional.

Printer: Spanish and English cards. Add Finnish only if 26 or more of Eero's family confirm. An RSVP decision date is to be set, and quotes requested for both versions as a fallback.
